name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Turning Tool
tagline: TURNING TOOL FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Turning Tool is an attachment that, when used with a power tool, attaches to the top of adjustable pedestals to easily and quickly adjust the height of the pedestal. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Turning Tool is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® pedestals, and helps to screw or unscrew the pedestals to adjust their heights at a faster pace for quicker installation times.
